content: PHP official migration guide says PHP 8.3 has backward-incompatible changes and deprecated features to test before production; migration is cumulative from the plugin’s actual minimum-era syntax, not only an 8.2-to-8.3 diff. GigPress includes curly-brace string offsets in gigpress.php and bundled CSV/upgrade libraries; this syntax was removed in PHP 8.0 and can prevent loading before runtime behavior is exercised. PHP 8.2 warning is diagnostic evidence, not a PHP 8.2 support promise; validate target PHP 8.3+ matrix.
